sections.title: Read this first
blocks: Results come from the runner's latest log for each setup group. Every figure and quote is what the runner read from the page.

items: Failed does not yet mean defect. The runner's seat-detail checks were written for other suppliers and have not been reviewed against this supplier's screens.

TC-SM-SEL-003 is under review: a tester screenshot of seat 3D shows the price (EGP 890 per passenger) and cabin (Economy) in the seat panel, which the check reported as missing. Treat it as a probable check problem until the check is corrected and rerun.

The runner picked the first flight from this credential, which connects via IXB (Bagdogra). Seat map counts and package comparisons can differ for a connecting trip, so TC-SM-RND-010, RTP-001, BND-003 and RTP-003 need review against the case wording.
Group 03 (women-only seats) could not run: the flight the runner picked has no women-only seats.
Group 11 (second flight on a different aircraft, TC-SM-RND-007): the runner uses a multi-city search, and no multi-city flights were found for this credential.
Group 12 (non-EGP credential, TC-SM-PRC-005): the run has no non-EGP credential, currency or ROE configured.
Group 13 (wallet and My Bookings baseline): see the case results above.
Group 10 and the multi-city cases (TC-SM-MCT-003 to 007) are excluded: the supplier does not support the multi-city trip type.
Groups 14-17 (booked, held and paid cases) are assisted and headed only, and spend real money. They were not run.
